items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Slashing damage. If the target has the Poisoned condition, it has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Festering Aura
items.notes: Any creature (other than you) that starts its turn within a 5-foot Emanation originating from the spirit must make a Constitution saving throw. DC equals your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

items.name: Grave Bolt
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: YourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 150 ft. Hit: 2d4 + 3 + summonSpellLevel Necrotic damage.
